LAW AND MOTION 301, THE COURT ADOPTED IT'S TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS - DEFENDANT SCOTT TODD'S MOTION TO SEAL RECORDS AND REGISTER OF ACTIONS IS DENIED. DEFENDANT DOES NOT QUALIFY FOR RELIEF UNDER C C P SECTION 1161.2 AND, EVEN IF IT WERE PROPER TO SEAL RECORDS ALREADY IN THE PUBLIC FILES, DEFENDANT HAS FAILED TO ESTABLISH A BASIS TO DO SO UNDER C R C 2.550 AND 2.551. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR 8189
